title: BV Financial's Q2 Earnings Rise Y/Y on Lower Funding Costs
summary: BVFL's Q2 earnings per share are aided by higher net interest income, improved margins and reduced borrowing costs, while lower loan balances and softer noninterest income weigh on performance.
